Theoretic estimates of survival time of starved and semi-
starved infants are shown in Table 42-2. These estimates assume 
depletion of all glycogen and fat and approximately one third of 
body protein tissue at a rate of 50 kcal/kg/day. The effects of 
fluids such as intravenously provided water (which has no ex-
ogenous calories) and 10% dextrose solution (D10W) are 
shown. Currently, PN fluids are started on the day of birth to 
provide energy and protein for the VLBW infant. Early protein 
intake promotes positive nitrogen balance, normal plasma 
amino acid levels, and glucose tolerance.
